properties.statement: Parsed the committed export with a throwaway python script to count what VALUES a property carries across every edge of one kind — for CAUSES: validation_status (unvalidated 139 / validated 21 / hypothesis 6 / refuted 0) and basis (correlational 137 / observed 18 / causal 11 / spurious 0), and separately the fact_type spread across 639 TemporalFacts. `relation_coverage` answers how many nodes of a kind CARRY a relation; nothing answers what values the property on it holds. The distribution was the whole finding — it showed a declared four-value vocabulary sitting at one default because no served tool can set it, which a count could never have revealed. Checked with find_tools before concluding: 187 tools searched, best matches were set_verification_kind, scan_nodes and create_edges, none of which does this.
